# Agent Citation Wire Fixture

`golden.json` is synthetic data generated by the actual Agent dictionary builders
and `freeze_citations`, including their omission of null target fields. No UI
schema or UI serialization generates these expected bytes.

`source.json` records the exact producer source SHA256 and all builder inputs.
The producer is uncommitted refactor code; `base_commit` is repository context,
not a claim that the new module exists in that commit.

To regenerate against the recorded producer, import
`vibesim_agent.domain.evidence`, iterate `source.json.inputs` as
`(kind, builder_name, arguments)`, and call `getattr(evidence, builder_name)(**arguments)`.
Choose the last dictionary entry for aggregate (to exercise member coordinates)
and the first entry for the other kinds. Set `text = f"Evidence `{entry.token}`."`;
store `kind`, `text`, `dictionary.model_dump(by_alias=True)`, and
`evidence.freeze_citations(text, dictionary)[0]` under `citation`.
Serialize the list with `json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n"`.
Verify the recorded producer SHA before regeneration and update the golden SHA
when intentionally accepting a different producer. Preserve omitted fields.
